'''Monkabi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of [[Ukabi]]'s [[lieutenant]]s during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was defeated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-allied individual.<ref name="SW TOR" />
